candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders fails with HTTP 500. Traces and logs show each 502 checkout correlated with a 500 from order, so the fault originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs, traces and metrics are absent; the specific order failure mode (db, redis, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently paired with order POST /v1/orders 500s in traces and logs, and topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded cause is an order-service 500 propagating to the gateway; the underlying order-side fault is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders 500 responses to identify the failing dependency or exception
Order service metrics (db pool, redis latency, error rates) to distinguish db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or bad-configuration
